main.description: Mint a short-lived playback token for the caller's own live stream, so their player can watch it over HLS before it is published (pre-live). HLS requests carry no session; the token, passed as `token` on getLivePlaylist and getLiveSegment, stands in for one. Requires an authenticated session; the token is bound to the caller's DID.

token.description: Opaque token to pass as the `token` query parameter.

expiresAt.description: When the token stops working; fetch a new one before then.
